head: 9b5b9e29a48950591f9e06d7acb7d2d3095cae4b
scope: Independent static review of exact two changed production files and new finality join fixture; diagnostics-only actual-native fixture diff, adjacent evidence/bootstrap/worker fixtures, runtime hook integration, pinned algorithm and module contracts. Review does not qualify full program or native executions.

reviewed_paths.binding_admission: Non-begin payloads await the actual begin acknowledgment and retain original payload/lifecycle identity. Explicit false admission emits no metric/end finality.
reviewed_paths.same_lifecycle_join: Repeated finish calls return the same complete Promise; metric/end acknowledgments stay inside it, with the first boundary preserved.
reviewed_paths.restore_retirement: A captured lifecycle token is checked before draining, each final metric and end; restore resets its own admission/finish receipt so an old finish cannot emit under or terminalize the new token.
reviewed_paths.late_native_frames: Current native frames are deduplicated and attempted before retained stale handles, up to the established frame limit; overflow marks evidence incomplete. Existing two-second owned-context cancellation and worker/close joins remain intact.
reviewed_paths.observation_semantics: The pinned web-vitals digest and immutable accepted final states remain; no synthetic target events, HTTP probes, values or thresholds are introduced.
reviewed_paths.fixtures: VM begin gate/rejection, active finish joining and BFCache retirement, late child discovery and bounded deduplication cover the corrected seams. Actual native oracle adds aggregate-only diagnostic states; identity, finality/no-interaction and exact target counters are unchanged.

limitations: No builds, tests, controller or browser were started by this reviewer. Native20-repeat qualification remains owned by HAR agent; prior full-suite failure is retained.
Adjacent dependency files were read for relevant contracts; this receipt is not a full transitive or whole-program review.
